overview_description.description: Brantu is a fashion technology company. They sell women's shoes, fashion, and accessories including clothes, dresses, shoes, jackets, shorts, skirts, and accessories. They build the fashion operating system by digitizing the fashion supply chain connecting brands, retailers, and manufacturers in markets.
